annotations.title: LIHTC properties reaching Year 15 in a state

description: Lists tax credit properties in one state from HUD's LIHTC database (placed in service 2009 to 2018) with name, HUD id, city, units, low-income units, credit type and estimated compliance-period end year. Filter by end year (2023 to 2032), city, minimum units or credit type; returns the total matched and a page of rows.

city.description: City as HUD lists it, e.g. "Houston".

compliance_end_year.description: Estimated year the 15-year compliance period ends (placed-in-service year + 14), e.g. 2027.

credit_type.description: Credit type decoded from HUD's CREDIT field.

limit.description: Rows to return (default 10, max 50). Sorted by units, largest first.

min_units.description: Only properties with at least this many total units.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, e.g. TX.

name: find_year15_properties
title: LIHTC properties reaching Year 15 in a state
